program.purpose: Host-attached lattice and Keccak accelerator for Suwappu bridge and chain verification paths

required_submission.vendor_integration: ChipFoundry integrates the user-area GDSII with the golden OpenFrame

retained_functions: ML-KEM-768 and ML-DSA-65 forward and inverse 256-coefficient NTT primitives
dual-modulus add, subtract, multiply, and reduce primitives
bounded host CSR and sequential stream control
status, sticky error, interrupt, self-test, abort, and zeroize control
32 KiB compiled SRAM baseline with a separately measured 64 KiB experiment
excluded_functions: PicoRV32 or any other on-die general-purpose CPU
autonomous ML-KEM key generation or encapsulation
autonomous ML-DSA key generation or signing
complete protocol parsing, bridge policy, finality, replay protection, routing, or chain execution
on-die entropy generation, key provisioning, or lifecycle fuses
debug unlock, scan access, or unauthenticated factory-test mode
TEE, attestation, FIPS validation, side-channel resistance, fault resistance, or production-key claims
AI inference acceleration or confidential-inference performance claims
host_responsibilities: algorithm sequencing around the exposed NTT and Keccak primitives
all long-lived key storage and policy enforcement
bridge finality, replay protection, routing, chain state, and transaction execution
timeouts, retry policy, output authentication, and fail-closed handling
confidential-compute isolation or cryptographic privacy protocol when private inference is offered

rtl_disposition.action: Keep as a bit-exact arithmetic reference and regression target; do not count it as an instantiated Rev-A block unless synthesis selects it.
Replace the CPU/ROM/512-KiB/whole-message prototype top with the bounded OpenFrame link and accelerator-only Rev-A top.
Exclude from Rev-A because it retains complete protocol objects and implements the obsolete command ABI.
Retain the 24-round permutation engine; reverify reset, abort, state load/read, and zeroize through the new shell adapter.
Keep as a characterized constant-iteration reference while the integrated arithmetic lane is selected by synthesis evidence.
Retain the Level-3 NTT/INTT behavior; add the sequential shell stream adapter and harden its coefficient storage deliberately.
Retain generated constants and pin their generator/source hash in the physical release manifest.
Keep only as a behavioral simulation model; replace the silicon implementation with the selected compiled SRAM wrapper.

experiment.promotion_rule: Promote only if the same pinned OpenFrame run closes area, timing, IR/EM, and price without weakening zeroize coverage.

shell_interface.name: LCA-LINK-16
shell_interface.external_reset: OpenFrame resetb_l derived from QFN pin 21
shell_interface.request_acceptance: Sample on the rising host clock edge when req_valid and req_ready are both high.
shell_interface.response_acceptance: Hold response data, rsp_last, and rsp_valid stable until rsp_valid and rsp_ready are both high on a rising edge.
shell_interface.bus_turnaround: The host releases host_d no later than the accepted read request edge. The chip drives host_d only while rsp_valid is asserted.

address_classes.name: CSR halfwords
address_classes.semantics: req_write selects write or read; each transaction transfers one little-endian 16-bit halfword.

address_classes.name: Sequential data channels
address_classes.semantics: Even addresses select a channel. Address bit 0 marks a one-byte final write beat; req_last marks the final beat. Read channels return one halfword per accepted request.

control_bits.name: START
control_bits.semantics: Validate command and exact staged length, then launch only when idle.

control_bits.name: ABORT
control_bits.semantics: Cancel work, clear visible response, and zeroize all touched state before accepting another request.

control_bits.name: CLEAR_DONE
control_bits.semantics: Clear done and non-tamper error state only when idle.

control_bits.name: ZEROIZE_ALL
control_bits.semantics: Always honored; blocks ready and scrubs all compiled SRAM and engine state.

control_bits.name: RESET_STREAM_CURSORS
control_bits.semantics: Reset sequential channel cursors only when idle.

reset_abort_zeroize.power_on_behavior: Keep req_ready low, outputs benign, and engines held until the complete SRAM scrub and self-test state initialization finish.
reset_abort_zeroize.abort_behavior: Discard partial requests and responses, clear engine state, and perform a complete scrub of every selected SRAM bank before accepting another request.
reset_abort_zeroize.tamper_behavior: An active-low tamper_n assertion is sticky, suppresses all externally visible secret data, and initiates full zeroize.
reset_abort_zeroize.illegal_request_behavior: Reject without modifying accelerator or SRAM state; latch a sticky error and assert irq/fault.
reset_abort_zeroize.zeroize_completion: Only deassert zeroize_busy and reassert req_ready after every selected SRAM bank and every retained engine state has been cleared.
